relationships.subject: OnabotulinumtoxinA
relationships.evidence_quote: The mechanism of BoNT/A treatment for headache is by preventing peripheral nerves from releasing pain-inducing neuropeptides including CGRP, pituitary adenylate cyclase-activating polypeptide (PACAP), and glutamate

relationships.subject: NSAIDs
relationships.evidence_quote: NSAIDs with a focus on cyclooxygenase (COX)-2 inhibition

key_findings: PCH affects roughly 60-70% of craniotomy patients; BoNT/A case series show improvement in all reported patients.
CGRP-targeted agents are untested in PCH, with increased CGRP reported after craniotomy in animal models.
